chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kufi, from one of his companions, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Yazeed ibn Khalifa al-Khowlani (who is Yazeed ibn Khalifa al-Harithi), who said:
'Isa ibn Abdullah asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) while I was present, and he said, 'The women go out to the funeral.' He (peace be upon him) was reclining, so he sat upright.

Then he said, 'The evil-doer, upon him is the Curse of Allah. His uncle, Al-Mughira ibn Abi al-'As, sheltered him, and he was among those whose blood the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) permitted to be spilled.'
He said to the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), 'Do not inform your father of his whereabouts,' as if he was not convinced that Revelation comes to Muhammad.
She said, 'I was not one to conceal from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) his enemy.' So he placed him in a cupboard of his and wrapped him in a velvet cloth.

Revelation came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and informed him of his place. So he sent Ali (peace be upon him) to him and said, 'Wrap up your sword, go to the house of the daughter of your cousin. If you find Al-Mughira, kill him.'

He went to the house and looked around in it but did not find him. So he returned to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and informed him, saying, 'O Messenger of Allah, I did not see him.'

He said, 'Revelation has come to me and informed me that he is in the cupboard.' And Uthman entered after the exit of Ali (peace be upon him), so he took the hand of his uncle and brought him to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

When he saw him, he stumbled upon him and did not turn towards him. And the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was bashful, benevolent. So he said, 'O Messenger of Allah, this is my uncle. This is Al-Mughira ibn Abi al-'As who has come.'
'By the One who sent you with the Truth, I have granted him safety.'
Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'And he lied, by the One who sent him with the Truth, he did not grant him safety.'

So he repeated it three times, and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) repeated it three times: 'How could I grant him safety? Except that he comes to him from his right, then comes to him from his left.'
So when it was the fourth time, he raised his head to him and said to him, 'I have given you three days. If I were to find him after three days, I would kill him.'

So when he turned around, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'O Allah, curse Al-Mughira ibn Abi al-'As, and curse the one who shelters him, and curse the one who carries him, and curse the one who feeds him, and curse the one who quenches him, and curse the one who equips him, and curse the one who gives him a drink-skin or shoes or clothes or a container.' And he was counting them with his right hand.

And Uthman went with him, so he sheltered him, and fed him, and quenched him, and carried him, and equipped him until he did all that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) had cursed upon for the one who does so with him.
Then he brought him out on the fourth day, ushering him. So he had not come out from the houses of Medina until Allah damaged his ride, and punctured his shoes, and his feet swelled up.

So he took assistance by his hands and his knees, and his supplies weighted him down until he became afraid of his life. So he went to a tree and sought shade with it. If one of you had gone to it, he would not have missed him (in his miserable condition).

So Revelation came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and informed him of that. So he called Ali (peace be upon him) and said, 'Take your sword and go, you and 'Ammar, and a third person for them.'
Go to Al-Mughira ibn Abi al-'As beneath such and such a tree. So Ali (peace be upon him) went to him and killed him.
So Uthman struck the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'You informed your father of his whereabouts.'

So she sent to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) complaining of what she faced. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent to her, 'Cover your shame. How ugly of the woman with a good lineage and religion, to complain of her husband every day.'

So she sent to him many times, during each of that he was saying that to her. So when it was the fourth time, he called Ali (peace be upon him) and said, 'Take your sword and wrap up upon it, then go to the house of the daughter of your cousin, and take her by the hand.'
If anyone comes between you and her, break him with the sword.
And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) came over flustered from his house to the house of Uthman.

So Ali (peace be upon him) brought out the daughter of the Messenger of Allah. So when she looked at him, she raised her voice with wailing, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) burst into tears and cried.
Then he took her to his house, and she uncovered her back. So when he saw what was on her back, he said three times, 'What is the matter with him hitting you? May Allah kill him.'
And that was on the day of Sunday, and Uthman spent the night covered with his slave girl.
So he remained (like that) for Monday and Tuesday, and she died on the fourth day.

So when it was time for her to be taken out, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) commanded Fatima (peace be upon her). So she went out (peace be upon her), and the women of the believers were with her.

And Uthman went out escorting her funeral. So when the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) saw him, he said, 'The one who went to his wife last night or with his slave girl, let him not follow her funeral.'
He said that three times, but he did not leave.
So when it was the fourth time, he said, 'He will leave or I will mention his name.'
So Uthman came over leaning upon a slave of his, holding his belly, and he said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I complain of my bellyache. So if you see fit, permit me to leave.'
He said, 'Leave!' And Fatima (peace be upon her) came out, and the women of the believers, and the Emigrants, so they prayed upon the funeral.

key_terms.الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْعَاصِ: Al-Mughira ibn Abi al-'As, a companion known for his enmity towards the Prophet
key_terms.عُثْمَانُ: Uthman ibn Affan, the cousin of Al-Mughira
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ ( عَلَيْهَا السَّلَام ): Fatima (peace be upon her), daughter of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What is the story of Al-Mughira ibn Abi al-'As and Uthman ibn Affan in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the theological concept of *al-amn* (guaranteed safety) by contrasting the Prophet’s questioning of Uthman ibn Affan with the certainty of divine revelation, establishing a precedent for the reliability of prophetic knowledge in Shia exegesis. It further illustrates the interplay between familial loyalty and religious duty, as Uthman’s sheltering of Al-Mughira leads to the Prophet’s specific curse upon those who provide him sustenance, culminating in the detailed account of Zaynab bint Muhammad’s funeral and the exclusion of Uthman from the procession.
